citations.text:
Mobile and Online Banking Help

Use this page to get started with Harbor online banking and the Harbor mobile app, and to troubleshoot common issues.

Signing In

I forgot my password. What should I do?

Select Forgot Password on the sign-in screen. We will send a one-time passcode to the phone number or e-mail address on file. Your new password must be at least 12 characters and cannot match any of your last five passwords.

Why is my access locked?

After five (5) consecutive failed sign-in attempts your access is locked for 30 minutes. After the lockout period you can try again, or reset your password immediately using Forgot Password. If you did not attempt to sign in, contact us, because someone else may be trying to access your account.

Can I use fingerprint or face recognition?

Yes. After you sign in with your password once on a device, go to Settings and turn on biometric sign-in. Biometric sign-in is tied to the device, so you will need to enable it again on a new phone.

Under the Account Closure Procedure v1.4, closing a retail account follows these steps: 1) Verify the member's identity (two forms of ID in branch, or three-factor phone authentication); 2) Obtain a signed Form HCU-ACL-220 (Account Closure Request) from every owner - phone requests are allowed only for single-owner accounts, and the signed form must still be returned by mail or secure upload before disbursement can proceed; 3) Review pending items, holds and scheduled transfers and note them on the form; 4) Cancel debit cards, stop recurring transfers and remove bill pay payees; 5) Move the account to Closing status and record the disbursement method; 6) Deposit Operations completes the pending items review; 7) Deposit Operations disburses the remaining balance and sets the account to Closed; 8) A closure confirmation letter is sent and the form is retained in the member file.

After the review period, remaining funds are disbursed by official check mailed within 7 business days to the address on file, unless the member requests a transfer to another Harbor member's account (with that member's consent) or a cash payout in branch (only if the balance is under $2,500). Dividends are paid through the date of closure.

Note: every joint owner must consent to closure, and closing the Primary Share Account ends membership and cannot happen while the member has an open loan. If the account is overdrawn at closure, the closure cannot be completed - the member is referred to the Overdraft Policy and a recovery case is created instead.

Premier Checking cardholders may have higher limits based on their relationship with Harbor, per the Debit Card Limits and Controls guide (effective 2026-02-02).
